title.english: Atika bint Abi Uzayhir ibn Anis ibn al-Hamq ibn Malik al-Dawsi.
title.arabic_observed: عاتكة بنت أبي أزيهر بن أنيس

segments.arabic:
١١٤٤٩- عاتكة بنت أبي أزيهر بن أنيس
بن الحمق بن مالك الدّوسيّ.
قتل أبوها ببدر كافرا، ثم تزوّجها أبو سفيان بن حرب، فهي والدة ولديه: محمّد، وعنبسة.
segments.english:
11449—Atika bint Abi Uzayhir ibn Anis ibn al-Hamq ibn Malik al-Dawsi.

Her father was killed at Badr as an unbeliever. Abu Sufyan ibn Harb then married her, and she was the mother of his two sons, Muhammad and Anbasa.

unresolved.explanation: The canonical consonants and the Urdu witness agree, but neither supplies vowels. The final text therefore retains the consonantally conservative form al-Hamq.
